heroLede: I'm **Prahlad Gaitonde**, a Computer Science undergraduate at Manipal Institute of Technology specializing in AI & Machine Learning. I build and publish applied ML systems — from healthcare decision support to classifying real astronomical events from false alarms — and bring a media production background to how I explain them.

about.heading: Where research meets production.
paragraphs: My work sits between two things I care about: **rigorous machine learning** and **making complex ideas legible**. I've trained models for healthcare decision support, built a lightweight classifier for astronomical transient detection that holds its own against a full CNN, and co-authored an IEEE conference paper on contextual similarity matching for chatbots.

Before I was writing training pipelines, I was producing how-to guides and marketing videos for AI product teams — which is why I care as much about a clean interface and a clear explanation as I do about a model's F1 score. That combination shapes everything I build.

Outside of coursework and internships, I keep a running list of side projects — from firmware validation frameworks to JavaFX reservation systems — mostly to understand a new layer of the stack by building something real in it.

contact.heading: Let's build something worth classifying as real.
contact.body: Open to AI/ML engineering roles, research collaborations, and internships. Reach out directly — I read every message.
